_comment: Synthetic case; every failure class the annotation pass has actually shown:
millers - 2-vs-1 split on a proper name (b heard ordinary words; majority is not agreement)
ladder  - direct 1-vs-1 verb split (a: borrowed, b: brought, c garbled there)
dana    - forbidden: one fluent reading, one omission, and one garbled fragment are not competing meanings
tired2  - divergence at the SECOND instance of a repeated phrase (c: 'we were all fine');
the anchor carries context so a note placed on the first instance scores as a miss
gate    - forbidden: quiet sentence only source a heard, others skip the whole stretch - never flag
tent    - forbidden: disfluency-only difference ('you know basically the tent the tent...') - never flag

tired2: exit twice and we were all tired

forbidden: cousin Dana called from the airport
